name: window-successions
of: A mechanism by which what one reasoner leaves for a successor that will never share its context fixes what the successor can conclude, must re-derive, or cannot know it lacks, named with the carrier, what it strips and who chose the stripping (the predecessor under its own limit, a compactor, a rule, the successor, nobody), the tell of a lossy handoff readable from the successor's side, and what re-deriving costs, and sorted by what the successor can read of the loss from its own side, from a loss that leaves no mark and may not be re-derived to a crossing in which nothing crosses because nothing was needed: a record with no character for what was lost, an order without its reason, a suite silent on the untested, a diff without its rejected branches, a summary read in place of the artifact beside it, a compactor's register, a name that does not resolve, a blank column, a stage stamp, a tree without a message, two artifacts that disagree, a predicate over live state, a handed object that can be asked, the negatives crossing with the positives, a seam that bounds the loss, a lesson written into the rule with its date, a generator instead of a result, and a baton.
items: Cold record: the successor reads a transcript that recorded every word and no face, so what only presence carried, the witness's pause, the tone that made the trial judge disbelieve, cannot be re-derived from the carrier, and the institution answers by forbidding the successor to try, as the appellate court that reviews findings of fact for clear error and defers on credibility to the trier who saw the witness, the arbitration award reviewed on the record alone, the consultant who reads the chart and not the patient; the carrier is the record, a stenographer's words and the exhibits; what it strips is everything the record's form has no character for, chosen by the form and by nobody in the room; the tell from the successor's side is none, since the record reads complete, which is why the tell is supplied by rule instead, a standard of review that names what the successor may not re-derive; re-deriving costs a new hearing with witnesses who are no longer in the state they were in, so the price is a remand and a second trial that is not the first; observed. Adds to witness-architectures' Second ear, which asks what must exist for a difference to leave a trace, the case where the trace formed and could still not carry the fact, and the successor's incapacity was written into law; not environment-loops' Once, the reader who cannot be asked twice, since here it is the successor who cannot ask at all.

Order without its reason: a standing rule crosses bare, so the successor can obey it and cannot tell where it stops applying, as the captain's night orders, 'call me if any vessel closes within two miles', obeyed by a mate who cannot judge the fishing fleet at three, the repair brief's 'touch nothing outside these three files', which a repairer obeys without knowing whether a scratch directory is inside the fence, the protocol's 'no aspirin' on a chart with the allergy history stripped; the carrier is the rule's sentence; what it strips is the incident or the reasoning the rule was written from, chosen by the predecessor, who wrote the rule to spare the successor the reasoning; the tell from the successor's side is a rule that reads complete and an edge case the rule's words do not settle, at which the successor must choose between obeying past the point and breaking the rule blind; re-deriving costs waking the captain, asking the lead, or the break itself; observed. Not Scar on the rule, where the incident crosses with the rule and the successor can judge the edge; not register-yields' Reserved word, a term the register refuses, since here nothing is refused, only unexplained.

Tests as the spec: the predecessor leaves a suite as the specification, so the successor can tell pass from fail and cannot tell which behaviours were the point and which the implementation happened to have, and a behaviour the suite is silent on reads as free, as the codebase whose only requirements document is its test directory, the regression test named after a bug number, the golden file that fixes the output byte for byte and says nothing about which bytes matter; the carrier is the suite; what it strips is the intent behind each case and the whole negative space of the untested, chosen by the predecessor's coverage, which was never a decision about the successor; the tell from the successor's side is a test named by the function it calls rather than by the behaviour it protects, and a suite that stays green through a change the predecessor would have refused; re-deriving costs breaking things on purpose and reading which tests object, so the successor learns the specification by violation; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Green by construction, where the reasoner who wrote both the code and the check reads green back as correct, the crossing: when the suite reaches a successor who wrote neither, the check is the only conversation left, and its silence is the loudest thing in it.

Diff without its branches: the commit carries the change complete and the message carries what the predecessor chose to say, so the alternatives tried and abandoned cross only if the message names them and by the form's default do not, as the commit that reads 'update parser', the migration whose two rejected schemas exist in no file, the textbook whose order of presentation replaced the order of discovery so that every dead end has been paved over; the carrier is the diff and its message, a form with a slot for what changed and none for what was declined; what it strips is the rejected paths and their reasons, chosen by the predecessor at the moment of writing the message, when the rejected paths were the most recent thing it knew and the least worth saying; the tell from the successor's side is a message that restates the diff, since a message that carries nothing the diff lacks carried nothing; re-deriving costs re-trying the rejected alternative at the full price of the original detour, and if it now works the successor cannot tell whether the predecessor was wrong or the world moved; observed. Adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Extinct question, an alternative that changed the episode by not occurring, the crossing that erases even that: to the successor the rejected branch never occurred and never mattered.

Abstract instead of the paper: two carriers cross, the artifact and a summary of it, and the successor reads the short one, so the stripping is chosen by the successor's own economy and the summary's errors become the successor's beliefs while the correct artifact sits unread beside it, as the reviewer who reads the abstract, the engineer who reads the commit message and not the diff, the critic who reads the ledger's accepted list and not the record, the author who reads a sibling map's of-sentence and not its items; the carrier is the pair, and the successor picks; what it strips is whatever the summary got wrong or left out, chosen by the successor, the one chooser this map's first breath had no place for; the tell from the successor's side is the long carrier present and unread beside the short one it holds, the one tell on this map the successor supplies to itself and can decline to act on; the failure, a claim that matches the summary and not the artifact, is visible only to a third reader with both in view; re-deriving costs the read the successor declined, and the successor cannot price it, because pricing it is the read; observed. Not Compacted, where the original is absent or unnamed; here it is present and named and the successor chose the loss; the fence is whether the long carrier was there to read.

Compacted: the window ends by a rule and a third hand writes the summary the successor starts from, so what crosses was chosen neither by the predecessor, who did not choose the moment, nor by the successor, who cannot see the original, but by a compactor working to a length under its own reading of relevance, as the session that was summarized mid-run and resumed by a successor that read its predecessor's work described in the third person, the discharge summary written by the covering resident from the chart, the minutes taken by a secretary who was not in the argument; the carrier is the summary; what it strips is whatever the compactor ranked lowest against the length, typically the evidence under a conclusion, the wording of an instruction, and the fact that an obligation is still owed, chosen by the compactor; the tell from the successor's side is the register, a summary that speaks of 'the assistant' as someone else, that turns 'X is owed' into 'the user asked for X', that states results without the command that produced them, and a summary that never names its own source, though the original transcript sits on disk under the session's identifier and could be read whole if the successor knew the harness kept it; re-deriving costs one read if the summary names its source and the whole re-run if it does not; observed. Not Name that resolves, where the predecessor chose the name; here the predecessor chose nothing, and the one name that would reverse the loss is the one the compactor is not asked to write.

Name that resolves: the carrier is a name, a slug, a path, a hash, a ticket number, a term the predecessor coined, and the successor's whole yield turns on whether its environment resolves it, since a name that resolves is a lossless pointer and a name that does not is nothing, as the fleet brief that hands an author 'environment-loops' and a directory, the handoff line that says 'apply the round-7 ruling' to a reader with no round seven, the note that says 'the usual fix'; the carrier is the name; what it strips is the referent, chosen by the predecessor, who could not tell which of its names would resolve because inside its window all of them did; the tell from the successor's side is a 'the' with no antecedent, a search that returns nothing, and the ledger's seed field, a name for a list that does not exist yet, read by no code and resolving only if a successor builds it, so the successor cannot tell whether it points at members; re-deriving costs a lookup where the name resolves and the entire referent where it does not, and the predecessor cannot price which; observed. Adds to item-grains' Two-slot name, which fixes what one item is by its name's form, the crossing: the name's form survives and its resolver does not; not Order without its reason, where the term resolves and the reason is what is missing.

Blank column: the carrier has slots, so an absence has a kind and a place, and the successor knows what sort of thing is missing even when it cannot know what, as the deck log with the column for set and drift left empty, the handoff form with 'allergies' blank, the ledger line whose residue field is an empty list, the flight strip with no assigned altitude; the carrier is a form; what it strips is everything the form has no column for, chosen by the rule that made the form, and within the columns nothing hides, since an empty column is visible; the tell from the successor's side is the blank itself, the one tell on this map that the carrier supplies before the successor does anything; re-deriving costs the column's measurement, since the form has told the successor which instrument to reach for; observed. Adds to form-yields' Blank column, where an empty cell in a form yields a member the pile did not hold, the crossing: here the empty cell yields an instruction to the successor about what to measure first; not Cold record, where the form has no column for what was lost and the loss has no place.

Stage stamp: the artifact carries its own position in the succession, so the successor knows which successor it is without the conversation, as the record marked 'pending critic admission' that tells a critic it has not been read and a repairer that it has, the chart's 'seen by' flag, the examiner's stamp on a patent file, the pull request's 'changes requested'; the carrier is a slot in the artifact reserved for the succession itself; what it strips is the history, every reason the artifact is at that stage, chosen by the schema; the tell from the successor's side is a stamp wrong for the artifact's position, a 'pending' record inside the admitted store, an admitted stamp on a record no critique names; re-deriving costs nothing for the stage and everything for the reasons; observed. Not Blank column, where the slot is about the subject and the blank is the tell; here the slot is about the crossing, and its value names the successor by role.

Inherited tree: nothing crosses but the environment's state, uncommitted changes, a half-written file, a process still running, and the successor must infer from the state whether the work was finished, abandoned, or cut mid-stroke, as the dirty working tree found at session start, the bench with a titration half done, the kitchen after the cook was called away; the carrier is the state; what it strips is intent, and nobody chose the stripping, since the window ended without a leaving; the tell from the successor's side is a diff with no message and files newer than the last commit, which say that something happened and not whether it ended; re-deriving costs archaeology, and the worst price is the one the successor cannot see: a state cut mid-stroke and a state left on purpose look alike, so the successor either absorbs someone's unfinished work as its own or discards it, and the rule that an inherited dirty tree is not absorbed before its owner's work is identified exists because the state cannot say; observed. Not Baton, where the state is the whole message and suffices; here the move depends on the intent the state cannot carry.

Silent fork: two windows re-derive what the carrier did not carry, land different answers in the same environment, and neither knows the other's exists, as the successor of a compacted session and a subagent launched before the compaction, each deciding the same slug, two authors writing to one scratch name in a shared directory, two mates each correcting the same course from the same stale fix; the carrier is the environment, which now holds both; what it strips is the order, since nothing recorded which derivation came second, and nobody chose the stripping; the tell from the successor's side is two artifacts that disagree with no record of which is later, or a file whose content is not what this window wrote; re-deriving costs the reconciliation, and the worst price is the later write that silently replaces the earlier and leaves nothing to reconcile, which is why an author's task in this fleet forbids generic scratch names in a shared place; observed. Adds to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Vector clock, the device that carries order across windows, the case where no such device was left and order must be inferred from disagreement; not environment-loops' Shared ledger, where another's lines return to the same reasoner as its own; here neither reasoner reads the other's at all.

Closes when: the obligation crosses as a predicate over the environment rather than as a status, so the successor closes it by measuring and the note cannot go stale, as the hand-written obligation files that read 'closes when the zone is active and the root returns 200 with the title', the runbook's 'done when the lag reads at most 200', the discharge order that says 'return if the fever passes 39'; the carrier is the predicate; what it strips is why the obligation exists, who it is owed to, and what to do when the predicate fails, chosen by the predecessor; the tell from the successor's side is a status where a predicate should be, 'pending', 'in flight', 'done', which was true at the moment of leaving and is now a claim about a world that moved, or a predicate whose terms name state that died with the predecessor, a monitor in a closed session; re-deriving costs one measurement, and the reason costs the person the obligation was made to; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Pull, not push, where the state lies in the environment until asked, the predecessor who left the question to ask; not clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Contract calendar, which reads a deadline from a document, since here nothing is dated and the state is read live.

Handed thing is a witness: the carrier is thin because the thing handed over carries its own state and can be asked, as the aircraft crossing a sector boundary with a strip of four fields and a pilot who will say altitude and intentions on request, the patient present at the bedside handoff, the user who sat through the compacted conversation and can be asked what was decided; the carrier is the object itself; what it strips is what the object does not know about itself, the previous controller's plan for it, the previous nurse's reading of a trend, the predecessor's reasons, chosen by the protocol, which sized the strip to what the object could not supply; the tell from the successor's side is that its first act is a question to the handed thing, and the failure is a question the thing cannot answer about itself, 'what did the last sector intend', 'why was I told to hold'; re-deriving costs one exchange for what the object knows, the cheapest re-derivation on this map, and the whole record for what it does not; observed. Not Cold record, where the witness cannot be recalled in the state it was in; here the witness is in the room and current.

Residue crossed: what was decided against crosses with what was kept, so the successor can tell an omission from a rejection and does not re-propose the cut, as the ledger's residue field, each rejected item with its why, the commit message that names the schema it did not choose, the referee report that lists the experiments the authors ran and dropped; the carrier is the list of negatives; what it strips is the cases that made the rejection visible, chosen by the predecessor; the tell of its absence from the successor's side is that silence about a member is ambiguous between never seen and rejected, so a critic re-proposes a cut item and cannot be told it was cut, and a successor cannot tell an obvious member's absence from a hole; re-deriving costs re-trying the rejected item at the price of the original trial; observed. Adds to composition-yields' Residue crossing to the fresh critic, where the yield is the critic's independent read of the rejection, the mechanism under it: a carrier of negatives converts the successor's silence into a rejection, and a carrier of positives only cannot.

Cut at a seam: the predecessor writes durable state at chosen points so that an end it will not choose, a compaction, a kill, an exhausted window, strips only what came after the last seam and the successor reads a whole, as the fleet brief's rule to save the record and the first ledger line the moment breath one is done, the watch that writes the log every hour so that a lost watch loses an hour, the loader that commits per batch so that a crash replays one batch; the carrier is the checkpoint; what it strips is the work after the seam, chosen in advance by the predecessor for a stripping it knows it will not choose; the tell from the successor's side is a seam timestamp earlier than the end and a stage stamp on the checkpoint, which together say how much is missing and of what kind; re-deriving costs at most one seam interval, which is the number the predecessor set when it chose the seams; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Read back from disk, where the file returns to the same reasoner, the case where it was written for a reasoner that would not be there; not Inherited tree, where the end cut wherever it fell and no seam bounds the loss.

Scar on the rule: a lesson crosses by being written into the standing rule with its date and incident, because the rule file is the one carrier every successor reads at start without being sent to it, so it is the one place a lesson reaches a successor that was not told to look, as the rule file whose entries carry the date of the incident that wrote them, the sailing directions that record the wreck beside the shoal, the checklist item that carries the crash it was added after; the carrier is the rule's own text; what it strips is the session, chosen by the predecessor, who chose to keep the incident that Order without its reason drops; the tell from the successor's side is a rule with a date beside a rule without one, since the dated rule lets the successor judge the edge and the bare rule does not; re-deriving costs nothing, since the scar is there to be read, and the price is paid differently: every successor reads every scar, so each entry is a tax on every window that follows, and the file grows toward the size at which it must itself be summarized; observed, with a remote case that names the barrier: the germ line carries the parent's prior and none of the parent's life, no lesson of the body can be written into it, so biology forbids exactly the crossing a rule file permits, and the antibody handed across the placenta and in the milk is the one side channel, with a half-life. Adds to learning-that-commits' Knowing obliges, where a finding binds the finder, the finding written so that it binds the successor instead.

Recipe not result: the predecessor leaves the generator and not the generated, a script, a lockfile, a seed with a deterministic process, a build expression, so the successor regenerates the state and re-derivation is compute rather than thought, as the reproducible build that ships no binary, the notebook checked in without its outputs, the seriation whose order the engine re-measures from the items rather than copying the predecessor's note; the carrier is the generator; what it strips is nothing the generator can regenerate and everything the environment has changed since, chosen by the predecessor, who bet that the environment would hold still, and by the environment, which did not; the tell from the successor's side is a regeneration that does not match a leftover result, or a generator that names its inputs by floating version where a lockfile should be; re-deriving costs the run, which is the intended price, and the run's divergence, which is not; observed. Not Cut at a seam, where the state itself crosses at intervals; here the state never crosses and is remade, so the loss is not after a seam but wherever the world moved under the recipe.

Baton: nothing crosses but the token, and the environment's state, the lane, the position, the gap to the runner ahead, is the whole message, because the successor's next move depends on the state alone and on nothing the predecessor knew, as the relay where the receiver is already running before the baton arrives and takes it without looking back, the shift on a line that starts on whatever is on the belt, the on-call rotation that reads the alert queue and not the last engineer's mind; the carrier is empty by design; what it strips is the whole previous leg, the pace, the reason for the gap, chosen by the form of the task, which made them irrelevant; the tell from the successor's side is that no note is missed, and the succession's failure is not a stripping but an exchange, the dropped baton, the zone overrun, so this is the one crossing on the map with a window of its own; re-deriving costs nothing, since there is nothing to re-derive; analytical, since every observed relay carries at least a glance. Not Inherited tree, whose state looks the same and does not suffice; the fence is whether the successor's move is a function of the state.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: standards of review and cold records, night orders and deck-log columns, test suites named by bug number, commit messages that restate the diff, compaction summaries in the third person, slugs and seed fields that resolve or do not, 'closes when' predicates, flight strips and bedside handoffs, dirty working trees, per-breath checkpoints, residue fields, dated scars in a rule file, lockfiles and reproducible builds, exchange zones; drawn from appellate procedure, watchkeeping, air-traffic control, nursing handover, software practice, this repo's own ledgers and briefs, athletics, and developmental biology.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Baton is analytical and says so, since every observed relay carries at least a glance. Scar on the rule's germ-line case is an analogy and is marked as remote; maternal antibody transfer is documented and used as a shape. The compaction case is this run's own and is observed from the successor's side only, since the successor is the one writing. The loop's closing edge, that the rule file's editor cuts the incident and its date before the principle under a read budget, is observed in one rule file's standing instruction and not yet in its edit history, and is carried as the wild priority. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable critic review applied 2026-09-13
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; one handoff carries several of these at once, and a single summary can be Compacted, Name that resolves, and Stage stamp in one paragraph; the list makes no claim to cover every kind of crossing.

The seriation is an itinerary of what the successor can read of the loss, not a ranking of loss, trust, or cost; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, the loop, the incompatibility, and the dependency they draw are interpretations.

The cases from this repo (the session compacted mid-run and resumed by its successor, the hand-written obligation files with 'closes when' predicates, the ledger's residue and seed fields, the 'pending critic admission' stamp, the brief's rule to save after breath one, the rule against generic scratch names, the dated entries in a rule file) are read as they stood on 2026-09-13 and may change; the outside cases (standards of appellate review, night orders and deck logs, sector handoffs, bedside handoffs, relay exchange zones, reproducible builds, the germ line and maternal antibodies) are simplified to one mechanism each, and nothing here is legal or clinical advice.

Out by the declared type: a return to the same reasoner through an environment, which is environment-loops, and in particular the fresh critic's verdict returning to the author; a successor whose not-knowing is the point, the blind judge, the fresh critic, whose loss is a yield and belongs to composition-yields; a loss that creates a capacity, which is fertile-forgettings; what lies past the edge of a live window whose reasoner is still present, which is context-horizons; and a reasoner's own notes still in its window, where nothing crosses. In only where the predecessor is gone, the successor reads what was left, and the loss is a price the successor would refund if it could.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: environment-loops' Read back from disk holds the file that returns to its writer, where Cut at a seam holds the file written for a reader who will not be its writer; composition-yields' Residue crossing to the fresh critic holds what the crossing yields, where Residue crossed holds what the carrier of negatives does to the successor's silence; enumeration-stalls' Published as finished holds the list that stops at its own publication, where Stage stamp holds the artifact that tells its successor which stage it is at; item-grains' Two-slot name fixes the unit by a name's form, where Name that resolves holds the name whose resolver did not cross.

seriation.axis: What the successor can read of the loss from its own side, walked from a loss that leaves no mark and may not be re-derived to a crossing in which nothing crosses because nothing was needed: a record with no character for what was lost, an order without its reason, a suite silent on the untested, a diff without its rejected branches, a summary read in place of the artifact beside it, a compactor's register, a name that does not resolve, a blank column, a stage stamp, a tree without a message, two artifacts that disagree, a predicate over live state, a handed object that can be asked, the negatives crossing with the positives, a seam that bounds the loss, a lesson written into the rule with its date, a generator instead of a result, and a baton.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of loss, trust, or cost. Cold record opens it because its stripping leaves no mark on the carrier and the institution answers by forbidding the successor to re-derive, so the successor's incapacity is the one thing that crosses; Baton closes it because nothing crosses and nothing was needed. The first three stops, Cold record, Order without its reason, and Tests as the spec, are losses with no mark in the carrier: the record, the rule, and the suite each read complete, and the tell arrives only by rule, at an edge case, or when a wrong change stays green. Diff without its branches is the first stop whose mark is on the carrier at rest, a message that restates the diff, and it sits after the three unmarked stops for that reason. Abstract instead of the paper is the hinge where the mark moves off the carrier into the successor's own conduct, a long carrier present and unread beside the short one it holds, and the chooser of the stripping is for the first time the successor. From Compacted to Silent fork the mark is on the carrier or in the environment: a register, a name that fails to resolve, a blank with a place, a stamp, a diff with no message, two files that disagree. From Closes when to Cut at a seam the predecessor designed the crossing so that the loss is measurable, askable, distinguishable from silence, or bounded to an interval. Scar on the rule and Recipe not result are the two crossings in which nothing needs re-deriving, the lesson because it was written into the one file every successor reads without being sent to it, the result because the generator crosses instead, and each pays elsewhere, in a tax on every later window and in the run's divergence. The mirrored pair at the centre is Compacted and Abstract instead of the paper, the same summary read by a successor who had no original and by one who had it and declined it; the pair at the end is Recipe not result and Baton, the generator that remakes the state and the state that needs no generator.

relations.label: If the successor's next move is a function of the state alone, the inherited tree is a baton, the missing note costs nothing, and the only failure left is the exchange; where the move depends on whether the predecessor had finished, the same tree is a crash site and every file newer than the last commit must be read as unfinished until shown otherwise.

relations.to: Scar on the rule: a lesson crosses by being written into the standing rule with its date and incident, because the rule file is the one carrier every successor reads at start without being sent to it, so it is the one place a lesson reaches a successor that was not told to look, as the rule file whose entries carry the date of the incident that wrote them, the sailing directions that record the wreck beside the shoal, the checklist item that carries the crash it was added after; the carrier is the rule's own text; what it strips is the session, chosen by the predecessor, who chose to keep the incident that Order without its reason drops; the tell from the successor's side is a rule with a date beside a rule without one, since the dated rule lets the successor judge the edge and the bare rule does not; re-deriving costs nothing, since the scar is there to be read, and the price is paid differently: every successor reads every scar, so each entry is a tax on every window that follows, and the file grows toward the size at which it must itself be summarized; observed, with a remote case that names the barrier: the germ line carries the parent's prior and none of the parent's life, no lesson of the body can be written into it, so biology forbids exactly the crossing a rule file permits, and the antibody handed across the placenta and in the milk is the one side channel, with a half-life. Adds to learning-that-commits' Knowing obliges, where a finding binds the finder, the finding written so that it binds the successor instead.
relations.label: If a successor breaks a bare order at an edge the order's words did not settle, the repair that crosses is the incident and its date written beside the order, so the next successor can judge the edge; each break at an unnamed edge adds a scar, and an order that has never been broken stays bare.

relations.from: Compacted: the window ends by a rule and a third hand writes the summary the successor starts from, so what crosses was chosen neither by the predecessor, who did not choose the moment, nor by the successor, who cannot see the original, but by a compactor working to a length under its own reading of relevance, as the session that was summarized mid-run and resumed by a successor that read its predecessor's work described in the third person, the discharge summary written by the covering resident from the chart, the minutes taken by a secretary who was not in the argument; the carrier is the summary; what it strips is whatever the compactor ranked lowest against the length, typically the evidence under a conclusion, the wording of an instruction, and the fact that an obligation is still owed, chosen by the compactor; the tell from the successor's side is the register, a summary that speaks of 'the assistant' as someone else, that turns 'X is owed' into 'the user asked for X', that states results without the command that produced them, and a summary that never names its own source, though the original transcript sits on disk under the session's identifier and could be read whole if the successor knew the harness kept it; re-deriving costs one read if the summary names its source and the whole re-run if it does not; observed. Not Name that resolves, where the predecessor chose the name; here the predecessor chose nothing, and the one name that would reverse the loss is the one the compactor is not asked to write.

relations.to: Residue crossed: what was decided against crosses with what was kept, so the successor can tell an omission from a rejection and does not re-propose the cut, as the ledger's residue field, each rejected item with its why, the commit message that names the schema it did not choose, the referee report that lists the experiments the authors ran and dropped; the carrier is the list of negatives; what it strips is the cases that made the rejection visible, chosen by the predecessor; the tell of its absence from the successor's side is that silence about a member is ambiguous between never seen and rejected, so a critic re-proposes a cut item and cannot be told it was cut, and a successor cannot tell an obvious member's absence from a hole; re-deriving costs re-trying the rejected item at the price of the original trial; observed. Adds to composition-yields' Residue crossing to the fresh critic, where the yield is the critic's independent read of the rejection, the mechanism under it: a carrier of negatives converts the successor's silence into a rejection, and a carrier of positives only cannot.
relations.label: If the compactor keeps what was concluded and drops what was decided against, then residue cannot survive a compaction and the successor re-proposes the rejected item; the two carriers are incompatible under a length limit unless the residue was written into the environment before the window closed, which is what a ledger's residue field is for.

relations.from: Name that resolves: the carrier is a name, a slug, a path, a hash, a ticket number, a term the predecessor coined, and the successor's whole yield turns on whether its environment resolves it, since a name that resolves is a lossless pointer and a name that does not is nothing, as the fleet brief that hands an author 'environment-loops' and a directory, the handoff line that says 'apply the round-7 ruling' to a reader with no round seven, the note that says 'the usual fix'; the carrier is the name; what it strips is the referent, chosen by the predecessor, who could not tell which of its names would resolve because inside its window all of them did; the tell from the successor's side is a 'the' with no antecedent, a search that returns nothing, and the ledger's seed field, a name for a list that does not exist yet, read by no code and resolving only if a successor builds it, so the successor cannot tell whether it points at members; re-deriving costs a lookup where the name resolves and the entire referent where it does not, and the predecessor cannot price which; observed. Adds to item-grains' Two-slot name, which fixes what one item is by its name's form, the crossing: the name's form survives and its resolver does not; not Order without its reason, where the term resolves and the reason is what is missing.
relations.to: Closes when: the obligation crosses as a predicate over the environment rather than as a status, so the successor closes it by measuring and the note cannot go stale, as the hand-written obligation files that read 'closes when the zone is active and the root returns 200 with the title', the runbook's 'done when the lag reads at most 200', the discharge order that says 'return if the fever passes 39'; the carrier is the predicate; what it strips is why the obligation exists, who it is owed to, and what to do when the predicate fails, chosen by the predecessor; the tell from the successor's side is a status where a predicate should be, 'pending', 'in flight', 'done', which was true at the moment of leaving and is now a claim about a world that moved, or a predicate whose terms name state that died with the predecessor, a monitor in a closed session; re-deriving costs one measurement, and the reason costs the person the obligation was made to; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Pull, not push, where the state lies in the environment until asked, the predecessor who left the question to ask; not clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Contract calendar, which reads a deadline from a document, since here nothing is dated and the state is read live.
relations.label: If every term of the predicate resolves in the successor's environment, the obligation can be closed by one measurement and the note cannot go stale; where a term names a monitor, a session, or a scratch file that died with the predecessor, the predicate is a name that does not resolve, and the obligation reads as open forever with nothing to measure.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does what one window leaves fix what the next window can conclude, what does each carrier strip and who chose the stripping, what tell can the successor read from its own side, and what does re-deriving cost?
exploration.changed_question: What crosses that is not a finding of the predecessor's, and who else can choose the stripping? Breath one wrote every carrier as a message from the predecessor about its own window, stripped by the predecessor under its limit, by a compactor, by a rule, or by nobody, and read by a successor who trusts it or measures against it. Pressing on Residue crossed, a carrier of what was decided against, and on the held Baton, a carrier of nothing, showed that the first framing assumed the carrier carries the predecessor's findings and that the successor only receives. The second breath found the successor choosing the stripping by reading the summary in place of the artifact beside it (Abstract instead of the paper), the lesson crossing not as a finding but as a dated scar on the one rule every successor reads (Scar on the rule), the generator crossing in place of the generated so that re-deriving is the intended price (Recipe not result), two successors re-deriving the same absent decision into the same environment with no record of order (Silent fork), and the empty carrier where the state suffices (Baton). The question turned from what the predecessor left out to what a crossing can be made of when it is not a message at all.
exploration.new_member: Abstract instead of the paper: two carriers cross, the artifact and a summary of it, and the successor reads the short one, so the stripping is chosen by the successor's own economy and the summary's errors become the successor's beliefs while the correct artifact sits unread beside it, as the reviewer who reads the abstract, the engineer who reads the commit message and not the diff, the critic who reads the ledger's accepted list and not the record, the author who reads a sibling map's of-sentence and not its items; the carrier is the pair, and the successor picks; what it strips is whatever the summary got wrong or left out, chosen by the successor, the one chooser this map's first breath had no place for; the tell from the successor's side is the long carrier present and unread beside the short one it holds, the one tell on this map the successor supplies to itself and can decline to act on; the failure, a claim that matches the summary and not the artifact, is visible only to a third reader with both in view; re-deriving costs the read the successor declined, and the successor cannot price it, because pricing it is the read; observed. Not Compacted, where the original is absent or unnamed; here it is present and named and the successor chose the loss; the fence is whether the long carrier was there to read.

neighbors.separating_case: The same summary of the same session is read by two successors on the same morning. The first opens in a window whose only input is the summary; the transcript exists on disk but the summary does not say so, and the successor does not know the harness keeps it. The second opens with the summary whose first line is the transcript's path, and reads the summary anyway, because the transcript is long. Both successors now hold the summary's one error, an obligation rendered as a description. The first is Compacted: nobody at its table chose the loss, and its only tell is the register. The second is Abstract instead of the paper: the successor chose the loss, and its tell is not in the carrier at all but in its own later claim, which a third reader with the transcript open can catch and the successor cannot. A reasoner who confuses them either blames the compactor for a read it declined, or reads a transcript path into a summary that never carried one. The tell that separates them is whether the long carrier was there to read.

checks.boundary_case: The tempting nonmember is the fresh-context critic, who reads the record and the ledger and is forbidden the author's reasoning by the repair brief. It has every feature of a crossing: a predecessor who is gone, a carrier, a stripping chosen by a rule. It is out because the loss is the yield, not the price; the critic would refuse the author's context if offered, and a critic that shares it is a worse critic, which composition-yields' Blind judge and environment-loops' Once hold. The fence is whether the successor would take the predecessor's context if it could: an author resuming from a compaction summary would, and is in; a critic would not, and is out. The second tempting nonmember is a reasoner's own notes still in its window, out because nothing crosses; the moment the window closes and the notes are read by the next window, they are in as Name that resolves, since the resolver the notes assumed has expired. Cold record sits on the fence with the critic and is in: the appellate court would take the trial judge's sight of the witness if it could, and the deference rule exists because it cannot, so the loss is a price the institution has made peace with, not a yield it sought.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the walk conceals: Order without its reason → Scar on the rule → Order without its reason, which says that the one carrier every successor reads at start without being sent to it is bounded by the read budget at the start of a window, and its scars are cut not by the compactor, which never touches a file re-read whole from disk, but by the file's editor under a keep-context-terse rule, keeping the principle and dropping the incident and its date; a later successor inherits a bare order at the edge the scar had named, the lesson is re-learned at the cost of the incident and re-written, and the loop's ceiling is the read budget, its chooser a fourth hand the of-sentence does not list, the editor who pays every window's read cost. Compacted feeds the same node by a shorter path: an instruction given inside a window with its reason crosses the compaction as the instruction alone, and reaches the rule file only if the successor writes the bare order into it. It shows a fork at Inherited tree, where the same dirty state is a Baton if the successor's move is a function of the state and a crash site if it depends on whether the predecessor had finished, and Cut at a seam is the only carrier that lets the successor tell which. It shows an incompatibility between Compacted and Residue crossed: under a length limit a compactor keeps conclusions and drops what was decided against, so residue survives a compaction only if it was written into the environment before the window closed, which is what the ledger's residue field is for and why the fleet brief orders the record saved after breath one. And it shows a dependency of Closes when on Name that resolves: a predicate closes an obligation by measurement only while every term resolves, and a predicate over a monitor that died with the predecessor is a name that does not resolve wearing a predicate's form. The inference the bare pile does not give is that the two carriers the atlas relies on to cross a window, the rule file and the ledger, both survive a compaction by being on disk, and differ in which hand keeps them under a budget: the ledger is read only by a successor sent to it and so is allowed to grow, and the rule file is read by every successor unsent and so is cut by an editor's hand, which is where the loop's loss is paid.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-13) judged the target preserved, not a self-read: every item is a mechanism with carrier, chooser, tell, and cost, no pair could be collapsed, the boundary fence (would the successor take the predecessor's context if it could) ruled every case tried, and the strange members (a record whose incapacity is codified as deference, a summary that would be reversible if it named its source, a name for a list that does not exist yet, a stamp that tells the successor which successor it is, a lesson that crosses only by taxing every later window, a carrier empty by design) are kept as mechanisms; the critic's repairs cut the loop's Scar-to-Compacted edge and re-scoped two overclaims rather than replacing any strange mechanism with a respectable one.
